# Is your boarding barn making money, and what board price do you need?

> Free profit calculator for horse boarding barns: stalls, occupancy, board price, feed, bedding, your own care time and fixed costs become monthly profit, break-even occupancy and the board price you need. Private, runs in your browser.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/horse-boarding-stall-profit-calculator/)
